title: Founder objective to coordinated execution
content: Cross-department workflow triggered when: Founder issues a high-level objective or instruction. The workflow must use explicit state, ownership and accepted handoffs; informal messages do not replace workflow state.

structured_data.trigger: Founder issues a high-level objective or instruction.

steps.action: Capture the objective verbatim, define desired outcome, deadline, constraints and success measure.
Check for conflict with company constitution, authority rules, open priorities and available budget.
Establish the baseline metrics and evidence needed to measure success.
Decompose the objective into department-owned tasks with dependencies and authority tiers.
Identify experiments, reversible pilots and cost-effective execution paths.
Assign tasks, subscribe departments to events and monitor blocked or overdue work.
Measure outcomes against baseline and identify unintended effects.
Close with a concise founder report: result, cost, risks, remaining work and recommendation.

definition_of_done: all mandatory steps completed or formally waived
final state recorded
downstream notifications complete
financial and data reconciliation complete where applicable

structured_data.trigger: A verified customer starts or resumes an inquiry.

steps.action: Interpret ordinary customer language and create ranked category/subcategory candidates.
Ask a targeted clarification if routing confidence is insufficient.
Load only the applicable category questions, technical rules and quotation requirements from the supplier corpus.
Extract attached files and map evidence to known inquiry fields.
Ask missing mandatory and conditional questions in approved sequence.
Run inquiry legitimacy and abuse controls.
Remove identity and contact details from supplier-visible text and files; fail closed on uncertainty.

title: Quotation collection, technical comparison and top-three recommendation
content: Cross-department workflow triggered when: One or more suppliers submit quotations for an inquiry. The workflow must use explicit state, ownership and accepted handoffs; informal messages do not replace workflow state.

structured_data.trigger: One or more suppliers submit quotations for an inquiry.

steps.action: Preserve the original quotation and extract items, totals, taxes, terms, inclusions, exclusions and attachments.
Validate quote ownership, inquiry linkage, revision and deadline.
Check each quotation against the structured inquiry, mandatory technical fields and category rules.
Normalize units, quantities, scope, commercial terms and explicit assumptions.
Identify technical deviations, missing certificates, exclusions, approval risk and substitution requirements.
Calculate auditable scores using configured weights and the customer's stated priorities.
Rank all valid quotations and select the top three without hiding access to the remaining quotations.
Generate an understandable English and Arabic comparison report that explains recommendation, trade-offs and unresolved risks.
Preserve all scores, rules, evidence and versioned report output for audit and challenge.
